Passbolt is an open-source password manager developed for team collaboration, emphasizing secure credential sharing.
Overview
Passbolt clients are available as browser extensions for web browsers like Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and provides a Windows desktop application as well as iOS & Android mobile applications. Passbolt uses OpenPGP for public key cryptography, offers multilingual support and is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Passbolt offers a European cloud-hosted service as well as the ability to self-host.
History
Passbolt first version was released in April 2016. In October 2016, Passbolt was selected among 200 startups to be part of the Luxembourgish national acceleration program Fit4Start. Passbolt development is managed by Passbolt Société Anonyme, a company incorporated in Luxembourg in November 2016. In December 2018, Passbolt closed a round of funding led by ‘Digital Tech Fund’, Luxembourg national fund for innovation.
Source code
The source code for the browser extensions, the Windows desktop application as well as iOS & Android mobile applications are available under the GNU Affero General Public License on GitHub.
Security
Since February 2021, Passbolt code has been audited by Cure53, an information security service provider.
To date, nine audit reports have been made publicly available. Since 2021, Passbolt successfully completed an annual SOC 2 Type II audit.
